acip: ,GAL TE 'DI DAG SEMS TZAM ZHES MKHYEN NAS, ,DE LAS GZUGS NYID DGAG PAR MDZAD NA NI, ,SLAR YANG DE LAS BDAG NYID CHEN POS SEMS, ,GTI MUG LAS LAS SKYES PAR CI PHYIR GSUNGS,
wylie: gal te 'di dag sems tsam zhes mkhyen nas, ,de las gzugs nyid dgag par mdzad na ni, ,slar yang de las bdag nyid chen pos sems, ,gti mug las las skyes par ci phyir gsungs
english: Suppose all these Were referred to As “only the mind,” And the Buddha Knew this, and so Meant in this To deny “form itself.” And then how Could it be in it For the Great Being To state that the mind Was born from Dark ignorance And karma?
